title: Construct String with Minimum Cost (Easy)
summary: Given a target string and an array of words along with their associated costs, construct the target string by appending words to an empty string s.
statement: Given a target string and an array of words along with their associated costs, construct the target string by appending words to an empty string s. The cost of appending each word is given by the corresponding value in the costs array. Determine the minimum total cost to form the target string, or return -1 if it is impossible to do so.
constraints: target and words use lowercase letters; words and positive costs have equal length at most 50.
Starting empty, append any listed word any number of times and pay its cost each time.
Return the minimum cost to form target exactly, or -1 if impossible.
hints: A valid construction partitions target into dictionary words, which is a shortest-path DP over prefix positions.
Store words in a trie so every matching word from a prefix is found in one forward scan.
For each reachable start, walk the trie through target and relax dp[end+1] at terminal nodes.
Every append corresponds to one prefix edge; DP relaxation considers all such edges and therefore finds the minimum path cost.
